Mechanical Engineering BEng/MEng at University of Manchester

What University of Manchester asks of applicants to Mechanical Engineering BEng/MEng for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Manchester courses · Engineering field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 8 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma from an accredited US school: Manchester typically requires the equivalent of three A-levels plus GCSE English and Mathematics/Science
  • SAT I 1290 or ACT 27 is listed as one way to meet the GCSE-equivalent part (alternatively the High School Diploma with a minimum 3.0 and grade 12 classes at the GCSE grade equivalent)
  • SAT/ACT is not listed as meeting the A-level part — that is met with three AP tests or dual-enrolment/college-level classes in separate subjects, plus the High School Diploma (GPA 3.0)
  • Mechanical Engineering: a High School Diploma alone is not enough — a suitable, recognised Foundation Year is required (or the AP route under Other qualifications)

University-wide guidance on Manchester’s page for students from the US (undated, current); it is not specific to this course.

Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Information for students from the US · Manchester: Country-specific entry requirements – Mechanical Engineering
English language
  • IELTS: 6.5 overall, no subskill below 6.5
  • TOEFL iBT: 90, no subskill below 22 (1–6 scale: 4.5 overall and in all subskills)
  • Pearson PTE: 70 overall, no subskill below 70
  • GCSE/IGCSE English Language 4/C (IGCSE English as a Second Language grade 8, CAIE, Oxford AQA or Pearson Edexcel)
Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: MEng Mechanical Engineering (2027 entry)

None listed on the official source

Subject prerequisites

Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: MEng Mechanical Engineering (2027 entry)
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • 3 AP exams at grades 5, 5, 5
    • Minimum GPA 3.2
    • Must include AP Calculus BC
    • Must include one of AP Physics 2 or AP Physics C: Mechanics
    • Not counted: AP Calculus AB, AP Physics 1

Requirements are published per department at Manchester and vary by faculty. These values are for Mechanical Engineering only (the third AP may be any other subject).

Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Country-specific entry requirements – Mechanical Engineering
Other requirements
  • No interviews; offer holders may be invited to a virtual webinar or on-campus offer holder day (February–April)
Verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: MEng Mechanical Engineering (2027 entry)
